這次☄️新衣裝的設計是由  石原 竜也  老師負責，過去設計與繪製過不少細節極多的戰術與軍服風的Holomem衣裝概念圖，衣裝製作則是交由大家都已熟悉的saekiyahiro老師負責（負責了🌸☄️近期新衣裝的設計和製作）

This new outfit of☄️was designed by Ishihara Tatsuya sensei, he had designed and illustrated many highly detailed Tactical and Military style conceptual outfits for many Holomems prior to this, and this outfit was created by saekiyahiro sensei, which many of you should be familiar with by now (designed and created those outfits of🌸☄️lately）
